feature: Single-equipment analysis with location and area
notes: Authenticated intake and workspace-scoped catalog reading persist in development. OPS-derived location and area values were provisioned with the operator CLI, read back from PostgreSQL, and verified in the intake selectors. Two synthetic sample locations remain in the development workspace; production readiness is not established.

feature: Manual/OEM documents, external research, or planner data used to draft a PM
notes: Planner notes and the development manual flow are implemented: PDF/DOCX/JPG/JPEG/PNG extraction runs locally; requested originals and review metadata persist in authenticated development PostgreSQL and pass read-back. New uploads fail closed while byte/page limits are unset; external research and technical generation are deferred.

feature: Source provenance, evidence references, and visible limitations
notes: Planner/manual metadata, applicability, locators, review state, and limitations persist. Reviewed applicable sources can be linked to frequency, duration, operating state, safety, individual task steps, and final verification; citations appear in PM preview/copy and survive drafts, read-back, splits, and approved snapshots. Extracted text remains in the browser. External-source references remain deferred.

feature: Direct sub-assets under an equipment hierarchy
notes: Equipment root and direct children can be edited and confirmed individually; deeper hierarchy is not available.

feature: Generate an English PM procedure with safety, operating state, actions, and final check
notes: The editor supports planner-authored safety, operating-state, action, and verification fields. It does not generate or technically validate PM content; generation is deferred by ADR 0002.

feature: Limit each PM to 15 steps and ask before splitting
notes: The editor enforces 15 total steps and supports a planner-authored split proposal with a chosen boundary, preview, and explicit confirmation. It saves two independent drafts with separate histories; a later proposal can split a continuation PM. Splitting an approved revision is not available.

feature: Review, edit, approve, and retain dated PM versions
notes: Local-prototype Playwright coverage and hosted plannermc-dev QA passed for revision draft reload, required summary, consecutive approval numbering, retained snapshots, read-back, identical retry, and stale-tab conflict. Production remains unconfigured and untested.

feature: Bilingual Spanish/English conversation by text and voice
notes: The authenticated planner can persist an es/en conversation-language preference with read-back; text conversation and voice input/output are not implemented, and speech remains deferred by ADR 0002.

feature: Copy PM manually to the selected CMMS
notes: Full PM and individual step copy actions are local clipboard actions; no CMMS is contacted.
